messages:
leo_support: Heads up — Orchid Labs onboarding hit a provisioning/SSO glitch during trial activation, escalated from support. Customer blocked on embed ingestion + SSO token exchange, trial users can't access the app.

leo_support: Error in logs: `oauth: token exchange failed: 502 from auth-service` followed by repeated 429s for embed ingest. Ticket created: INC-4721.

incident-bot: New incident INC-4721 created by leo_support — assigned to eng-oncall, priority P1-High.

marta_csm: Thanks for flagging. @sarah_cs can you take point on customer comms? We need a short comms plan & one-hour remediation ETA for Orchid. Renewal at risk if trial stalls >72h.

sarah_cs: On it. I'll send a proactive note to the customer within 30m. Draft: "We're aware of the issue and working on a fix; we'll keep you updated hourly, here's a temporary workaround." Approve?

leo_support: LGTM. Workaround is to generate a one-time API key and switch their embed pipeline to fallback endpoint `api-redwood-fallback.v1` until ingest recovers. Eng can enable.

aman_eng: I can enable fallback routing and look into 502 token exchange root cause. ETA for fallback flip: 20m. For token exchange 502, I'm seeing increased latency to Auth cluster from this region — will trace.

marta_csm: Great. Sarah, include the workaround steps in your comms: short how-to + who to ping. Also capture that we created INC-4721 and assigned eng.

sarah_cs: Draft sent to Orchids (cc: @marta_csm, @leo_support): "We're rolling out a temporary API key + fallback ingest endpoint; you'll see a console toggle under Settings > Integrations. Our engineers are working on a permanent fix. We expect restore in ~2 hours and will confirm once stable." :thumbsup:

leo_support: Customer replied: "Thanks — we'd prefer no key rotation if possible. Is there a way to just toggle on fallback?"

aman_eng: We can flip fallback without rotating keys — will do. Pushing config change now.

aman_eng: config patch applied, fallback routing active for tenant orchid-labs. Ingest 200s now, SSO token exchange still intermittent but reduced errors.

marta_csm: Thanks team. Action items: 1) Sarah — hourly comms until resolved + final postmortem to customer, 2) Aman — follow root-cause trace and ETA for Auth fix, 3) Leo — monitor customer sentiment & escalation. I'll mark as priority in CS tracker.

sarah_cs: Noted. I'll schedule a 11:00AM sync with Orchid success lead to walk through steps and reassure renewal touchpoint.

leo_support: Can we add a calendar invite for the sync? Customer prefers early afternoon PT.

sarah_cs: Sent invite for 12:30PM PT, subject: "Orchid Labs — Onboarding recovery & next steps".

aman_eng: Root cause: Auth cluster GC spike caused token exchange 502s. Working on autoscaler tweak + probe. Estimated fix in 6h; but fallback keeps trial usable.

marta_csm: OK—recording renewal risk: Medium-High (trial inertia). CS playbook step: offer extended trial + 1:1 enablement if restored >24h.

leo_support: Closing loop with support: please flag any downstream errors. I'll update INC-4721 with current mitigation & links to the comm email.

incident-bot: INC-4721 status updated: mitigation in place, P1 -> P2 (monitoring).
